about: BGE-M3 vectors of every kural. Model-generated: numbers, not text. The release refuses them once the kural text or the benchmark's input files change.

model.license_source: the YAML header of the model card (README.md) at that revision
model.license_file: none in the model snapshot used

run.run: one run of the retrieval benchmark with BAAI/bge-m3 (no query prompt; normalize_embeddings=True, batch_size=32); every kural embedded from the text as shipped

input.rule: each row's input is data/core/kurals.jsonl lines_ta joined with a newline, UTF-8; its sha256 equals the release's kurals.text_sha256

bench.script: the retrieval benchmark of embedding_model_choice.json, on the shipped text and the input files below

baseline.name: hash-trigram-4096
baseline.rule: character trigrams of the whitespace-free text, hashed into 4,096 counts, L2-normalised; no model. Cosines compared exactly, not in float32
baseline.computed_by: computed without a model on the same input files
